name: Thrash Boost
notes: Use: low-DIST tightener in front of a high-gain amp for thrash and modern death metal. DIST low so the pedal pushes the amp rather than distorting on its own, TIGHT 3 trims the flab, FILTER open for pick attack. Into a high-gain amp (TONE3000 70977 or 88689), V30-style cab (45023). Single path, no captures: renders from files in this repo only (the shared cab is the repo identity IR, a stand-in for a real cab). Rat-style op-amp distortion model (pedal.rat, VERMIN). Starting hypotheses, not a tuned tone.
